articles.title: Jason Kelce private jet: Inside the $12 million Swiss designed Pilatus aircraft reportedly associated with the NFL broadcaster
articles.summary: Jason Kelce spent 13 successful seasons in the NFL, amassing $81 million in total career earnings.
articles.body: Jason Kelce spent 13 successful seasons in the NFL, amassing $81 million in total career earnings. The former Philadelphia Eagles center’s estimated net worth in 2026 is $60 million, as per Celebrity Net Worth. The ESPN studio analyst continues to build his off-gridiron profile through broadcasting, endorsements, and podcasting.Among his luxury assets, the retired NFL star reportedly owns a $12 million private jet: a Swiss-designed 2021 model Pilatus PC-24 Super Versatile Jet, according to AeroCorner. The aircraft has nine seats, two Williams FJ44-series engines, and weighs less than 12,500 pounds, according to FlightAware.Jason Kelce’s reported private jet detailsJason Kelce’s reported private jet, Pilatus PC-24, bears registration number N620JK. “62” was Jason’s jersey number in Philadelphia. And JK could be short for “Jason Kelce.”The aircraft is registered under Kelce Air LLC, a Delaware-based limited liability company, as per FlightAware’s aircraft registration database. The registration identifies Kelce Air LLC as the owner; aviation reports like AeroCorner associate the aircraft with Travis Kelce’s brother, Jason Kelce.According to AeroCorner’s recent report, the private jet associated with the NFL broadcaster is a 2021-manufactured Pilatus PC-24. The aircraft’s registration certificate was issued in November 2024, while its airworthiness date is in December 2024. Its registry source is FAA. FlightAware also lists the same exact details.The Philadelphia Eagles star’s supposed aircraft is classified as a fixed-wing, multi-engine airplane. Its assigned registration date is November 2024, while its expiration date is November 2031, which is seven years from its registration. The registered owner is listed as Kelce Air LLC. And the listed address is New Castle, Delaware.As per StarStyleHomes, Jason Kelce lives in Haverford, Pennsylvania, a township in Delaware County on the edge of Philadelphia’s Main Line. That’s the Delaware connection. According to AeroCorner, the aircraft is based in Wilmington, Delaware, just 10 minutes from Philadelphia International. AeroCorner estimates the aircraft at $12.2 million.Pilatus PC 24 jet specifications and performanceSwiss aircraft company Pilatus manufactures the PC-24. It is called a Super Versatile Jet because it has a dual role: business-aviation comfort and short-runway performance.Two William FJ44-series turbofan engines power the jet. It has a thrust rating of 3433 pounds. Its takeoff distance is 3,090 ft. The PC-24’s maximum speed is 440 knots and a maximum range of 2,000 nautical miles with six passengers. It can operate from unpaved runways, including grass, gravel, earth, paved strips, and snow-covered surfaces.Its landing gear and design let it access smaller airports unsuitable for larger business jets. Inside, it boasts a spacious cabin, flat floor, and a large cargo door. It’s ideal for business travel and journeys that involve carrying extra baggage.Jason Kelce private jet and NFL travel lifestyleIn February 2024, after Super Bowl LVIII in Las Vegas, Jason Kelce was spotted leaving Harry Reid International Airport through the commercial terminal. Barstool Sports reported that Kelce chose commercial travel even though most wealthy attendees at the Las Vegas championship game preferred to fly via private aircrafts.He earned widespread praise from fans as a “man of the people.” The report noted that over 500 private jets had left the city, but Jason was photographed flying commercially. The commercial flight travel took place reportedly before the Pilatus PC-24 registration date.The reported super versatile jet was registered in November 2024. The Pilatus PC-24 is owned by “KELCE AIR LLC.”An article published by Tim de Vries of AeroCorner also points out that the only Kelce brother associated with an aircraft registered through Kelce Air LLC is Jason. Travis Kelce reportedly doesn’t own an aircraft, he charters and flies as a passenger, as per AeroCorner.Or maybe this N620JK belongs to all the Kelces. But if it were Travis’, then wouldn’t it be N870TK? Just speculating. His billionaire pop superstar wife, Taylor Swift, owns a reported $54 million Dassault Falcon 7X private jet registered as N621MM. Maybe he doesn’t need one. So the Pilates aircraft could be Jason’s. Stressing the word “could.”Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: NFL to review additional abuse allegations against Packers star Josh Jacobs following May arrest
articles.summary: Since Josh Jacobs was arrested in May, several women have contacted police with abuse allegations against the Green Bay Packers running back.
articles.body: Since Josh Jacobs was arrested in May after an incident in which a woman claimed he threw her to the ground, records show several other women have come forward with allegations of their own against him. The other women's abuse allegations are detailed in records from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department first obtained by NBC 26. The documents also contain new details about the incident that led to the Green Bay Packers running back’s arrest in May. "We will review these allegations as part of the investigation which has remained open," the NFL told OutKick in a statement. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE One woman contacted police in June 2026 about an alleged incident involving Jacobs in January 2022. The woman told police that the allegations against Jacobs from the investigation into the May incident sounded similar to her experience with him, according to the records. The woman was not identified. The woman believed her alleged experience with Jacobs could be relevant to the May 2026 case, and she contacted police because she wanted people to believe the woman involved in the incident. The woman claimed she had communicated with Jacobs for about six months before spending around 11 hours at his home. The woman then alleged that after she told Jacobs she hadn’t come there for sex, he became angry, slapped her across the face and told her not to disrespect him. She said he allegedly took her phone and threw it into a swimming pool when she attempted to leave, and that he grabbed her by the hair, threw her onto a bed, pinned her down, threw her to the floor and said, "I should kill you right now." She said Jacobs also spit on her. The woman said she hadn’t previously reported the alleged incident to law enforcement because she remained friends with Jacobs afterward and was concerned her allegations wouldn’t be believed. The woman said his condom broke, so she told Jacobs to get tested for sexually transmitted diseases because they both had been involved with other people. The woman claimed Jacobs later removed her from the residence, grabbed her by the arms and bicep area, pushed her against a wall and threw her belongings out. She told police that she sustained bruises to her arms and swelling in her rib area. Hobart/Lawrence police said they obtained records from that incident indicating that officers observed "no visible signs of injury, bruising or damage consistent with a physical altercation." Another woman alleged she had met Jacobs through social media and that he flew her to a residence in May 2022. She described an alleged altercation in which Jacobs grabbed her by the hair, placed his hands on her head and neck, dragged her, scratched her chest and took her phone after it fell to the floor. The woman claimed she got bruises on her arm and scratches to her chest and neck. She said she didn’t report the incident to police because she wasn’t a U.S. citizen at the time and Jacobs told her she could be deported. SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER Jacobs' lawyers — David Z. Chesnoff, Richard A. Schonfeld and Clarence F. Duchac III — issued a statement Saturday on their client's behalf: "The Brown County District Attorney’s office had these uncorroborated, old, and previously unreported allegations for months. They conducted their own exhaustive investigation, along with the police department, and the D.A. determined that only two misdemeanor charges were warranted. They then entered into a plea agreement with Josh Jacobs. Josh has repeatedly expressed his remorse and is honoring the terms of the agreement." OutKick reached out to the Packers and Jacobs’ agent but did not immediately receive a response. The records released Friday also offered more details of the May 23 incident that led to Jacobs’ arrest. According to the criminal complaint released in August, the woman told them that Jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door, causing her to hit her head. Police said Jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground. The records released Friday noted the woman said that while they were still in the home, Jacobs lunged at her, pinned her on the bed with his body weight on her chest and put his hand on her mouth and nose, so that she felt she couldn’t breathe. She also indicated that she believed she lost consciousness for a brief time when the confrontation moved to the garage. Jacobs pleaded no contest last month to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property. He was removed from the list last week, but the NFL is still conducting its investigation. In his two games since returning to the 5-3 Packers, Jacobs has rushed 32 times for 75 yards and a touchdown, averaging just 2.3 yards per carry. The three-time Pro Bowler has been more productive as a receiver, catching 11 passes for 68 yards and two touchdowns. After scoring one of his touchdowns in the Packers’ 27-19 win over the Carolina Panthers on Thursday, Jacobs had a controversial touchdown celebration. He insisted he wasn’t making light of his recent arrest and that the celebration was instead inspired by a gospel song. The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.title: Chiefs heiress Gracie Hunt shares hilarious Halloween costume idea as Kansas City looks to bounce back
articles.summary: Halloween costume ideas usually involve scary makeup, spooky outfits and plenty of creativity.
articles.body: Halloween costume ideas usually involve scary makeup, spooky outfits and plenty of creativity. But Gracie Hunt has come up with something rather unexpected this year. The Kansas City Chiefs heiress is giving fans a costume idea straight out of her own life: a bride getting ready for her wedding!Chiefs Heiress Gracie Hunt Has a Halloween Costume Idea for Every Bride-to-BeHunt recently shared a hilarious Instagram reel showing herself wearing a face mask, oversized orange sunglasses, a white head wrap and a towel wrapped around her body. With the text reading, "Halloween Costume Idea: a bride in wedding prep," she certainly made a convincing case for it.The bride-to-be even tagged @resurrectskinmd in the post, giving fans a glimpse of the skincare side of getting ready for the big day. And honestly, considering the amount of wedding preparation she has been sharing lately, Gracie might just be the perfect person to pull off this costume.Gracie Hunt's bridal era is in full swingGracie has been enjoying her bridal era ever since announcing her engagement to Derek Green in April 2026. Derek is the son of former Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Trent Green, making this a particularly special football-family connection. The couple had known each other for years before their relationship became public in 2025.Their engagement announcement was equally dreamy. Derek popped the question in a romantic setting surrounded by family, and Gracie shared the news with the sweet caption, "It was always you." Since then, fans have been getting little updates from the wedding-planning journey.Gracie has already revealed that she will have 14 bridesmaids, with her sister Ava serving as maid of honor. And if that wasn't enough, she has also been busy trying on wedding dresses. She travelled to New York with her mother, Tavia, and sister Ava for bridal shopping before making another trip to Dallas to explore more wedding gown options.In fact, Gracie joked that since a person only gets to try on wedding dresses once in their life, why not do it a bunch of times? The couple also recently shared dreamy pre-wedding photographs from Lake Como, Italy, in October. Between the romantic photoshoot, dress shopping and bridesmaid celebrations, there is certainly no shortage of wedding content coming from the Hunt family.Meanwhile, the Chiefs have some football business to handleWhile Gracie is busy with wedding preparations, her family's team has its own big season to focus on. The Kansas City Chiefs enter Week 8 with a 5-1 record, having won their first five games before suffering a 20-3 defeat against the Seattle Seahawks on October 25.Chief’s will now look to bounce back against the Denver Broncos on November 1. The divisional matchup could be an important one as the Chiefs look to maintain their position at the top of the AFC West.So, while Gracie might be busy preparing for her big walk down the aisle, the Chiefs will be hoping to get back to winning ways on the football field. One thing is certain: there is plenty happening in the Hunt household this season!Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Cardinals' Budda Baker fields questions about trade rumors while wearing evil clown Halloween mask
articles.summary: Budda Baker showed up in a creepy clown costume for his media availability, then had to field Arizona Cardinals trade deadline questions in full getup.
articles.body: Today is Halloween, but Arizona Cardinals safety Budda Baker got into the spirit a day early, showing up to his media availability in costume. According to The New York Post, dressing up for Halloween is a tradition for Baker. However, this year’s costume created an awkward situation that highlights a workplace risk few people consider when dressing up for spooky season. Baker is one of the names floating around the rumor mill as the Cardinals trend toward becoming sellers at the NFL trade deadline. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE So, while Baker rolled in dressed in a creepy clown costume, the journalists there still had to ask him about the trade rumors. And to his credit, he answered them... while still in costume. "I just live in the present, like today, having a great time with you guys," Baker said. "Going to go out and have a great Friday practice, and just focus on playing against the Dallas Cowboys and trying to get a ‘W’ at their stadium." It's a good answer, but until you read it, did you have any idea what he was saying? Or, like me, were you distracted by the fact that he was dressed like a clown that drives a primered van and steals people's organs? People dress up for work on Halloween whether they're bank tellers or NFL players. However, I think we forget that it is still work, and sometimes you'll need to get serious. And if you're still in the costume, that can be tricky. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! If you're a doctor, it might seem like a good idea to dress like a Minion on Halloween. But what about when you have to deliver the news of someone's terminal diagnosis and the zipper is stuck? Suddenly, it's not as great of an idea, is it? I mean, maybe it'll have some kind of Patch Adams effect, but I doubt it. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Fortunately, an NFLer addressing trade rumors isn't that serious, so we all got a hilarious Halloween moment. Now, moving forward, I bet Baker will factor trade rumors and whether or not he'll have to address them into his costume choice.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's charitable contribution of 70 million meals, 2.7 million winter coats and 8 million volunteer hours earns New York Cares' gratitude
articles.summary: In July, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce received a special message that put the spotlight on a meaningful part of their wedding celebrations.
articles.body: In July, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce received a special message that put the spotlight on a meaningful part of their wedding celebrations. Before getting married, the couple reportedly donated $26 million to charitable organisations across the United States. Among the beneficiaries was New York Cares, which recently shared a touching Instagram post expressing its gratitude. The organisation's message was more than a simple thank-you. It recognised how the couple had used an important milestone in their relationship to support people facing difficult circumstances, turning their pre-wedding generosity into something that could make a lasting difference.New York Cares shares emotional message for Taylor Swift and Travis KelceThe organisation shared a purple-themed appreciation card addressed directly to the newlyweds. Its message included a sweet reference to Swift's music, making the acknowledgement particularly special for the singer's fans.“Dear Taylor and Travis,We’re Enchanted to receive your generous gift to support New Yorkers in need.Thank you for making our mission a part of your Love Story.Best wishes,new york cares.”Alongside the graphic, New York Cares explained how the contribution would help strengthen its work across New York City. The organisation highlighted its efforts to address food insecurity, provide winter clothing and support children through essential resources.Its achievements include more than 70 million meals served, over eight million volunteer hours, 2.7 million winter coats distributed, more than 720,000 Winter Wishes granted to children and over 70,000 backpacks provided to students.For those unfamiliar with the organisation, New York Cares is a nonprofit that connects volunteers with community programmes across New York City. Its work focuses on supporting underserved communities through food distribution, education, winter assistance and other essential services.The organisation also encouraged Swift's supporters to take part in its charitable efforts, writing, "And to the Swifties who want to celebrate with us, we'd love to start your Giving Era."Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's $26 million donation supports charitiesNew York Cares was among more than a dozen organisations that publicly acknowledged the couple's pre-wedding contribution. Their reported $26 million donation reached charities in several cities with personal connections to Swift and Kelce, including Reading, Pennsylvania, Cleveland, Nashville and Kansas City.The Grammy Museum Foundation also thanked the couple for their "transformative gift", explaining that the contribution would help expand music education opportunities for students across the country.Kansas City's Harvesters food bank shared its own message of appreciation, writing, “We’d like to send a heartfelt thank you to @taylorswift and @killatrav for their very generous donation to our food bank just prior to their big wedding day. The two of them have incredibly big hearts and have shown up to support not only us but many charities over the years. We feel so lucky that they make the conscious effort to invest in hunger relief and the beautiful community we call Kansas City!”Dolly Parton also joined the list of well-wishers, thanking Swift and Kelce for their $2 million donation to her Imagination Library, which provides free books to children.While the couple's wedding attracted plenty of attention, their decision to support charitable causes before getting married gave the celebrations another dimension. New York Cares' message offered a reminder that their generosity reached far beyond their personal milestone.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Jonathan Taylor trade talks 'active and ongoing' as Colts now fielding calls on All-Pro running back: report
articles.summary: The Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks have all called about Jonathan Taylor as the Colts' NFL trade deadline fire sale heats up.
articles.body: It seems the Indianapolis Colts are indeed willing to talk about trading running back Jonathan Taylor after all. Multiple teams have reached out to the Colts amid their fire sale to see if Taylor is available, per ESPN and NFL Network. The talks "are said to be active and ongoing." Among those teams who have called the Colts and owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon are the Denver Broncos, Green Bay Packers, Minnesota Vikings, New York Giants and Seattle Seahawks. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE ESPN also reported that at least one offer included a second-round draft pick with additional compensation for Taylor. The Colts have already made it clear they would be sellers before the Nov. 10 NFL trade deadline following the firing of GM Chris Ballard after a 10-year stint with the franchise. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Indianapolis traded Quenton Nelson, their All-Pro guard and former first-round pick, to the Seahawks. Defensive tackle DeForest Buckner also reunited with the San Francisco 49ers just hours after Nelson was dealt this past week. Wide receiver Josh Downs, who is in the final year of his rookie contract, also reportedly requested a trade. The Colts have reportedly told teams he’s worth a third-round pick, though they wish to keep him if possible despite the trade request. Taylor, on the other hand, has expressed his desire to stay put in Indianapolis, but he also understands that’s out of his control. The Colts made it clear they’re looking to accumulate draft picks amid a season where they’re 2-5 in the AFC South. Irsay-Gordon and Taylor reportedly met this week and had an "in-depth conversation to discuss the future," per ESPN. It is believed Irsay-Gordon would like Taylor to be a part of the Colts’ rebuild, though the franchise understands the type of return Taylor, who just signed a two-year extension before the start of this season, could have if dealt. The Colts have already secured a 2027 third- and fourth-round pick as well as a 2028 fifth-round selection from the Nelson and Buckner deals. Indianapolis is also without a 2027 first-round pick, which the New York Jets own after dealing Sauce Gardner to the Colts in 2025. Ahead of the Colts’ game against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday, Taylor addressed the trade rumors surrounding him. "I haven’t heard anything," he said on Thursday, per FOX59’s Mike Chappell. "I can’t control that, obviously. Like you guys know, I’m proud to wear the horseshoe, proud to be here. Similar to Quenton [Nelson] and [DeForest Buckner], they were proud to wear the horseshoe, they were proud to be here. But obviously, circumstances may cause otherwise. Hopefully that day may not come, but I can’t control that." Head coach Shane Steichen understands the business of the NFL like Taylor, which is why he’s trying to focus on this upcoming game and the players he has on the roster. It’s hard losing Nelson, a linchpin at left guard, and Buckner, a veteran leader on the defensive line, ahead of a key divisional matchup. But those are the cards Irsay-Gordon and the front office have been dealt, as they look ahead to building for the future instead of the remainder of the 2026 season. articles.title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio estate faces fresh trouble as neighbors raise new objections over his security
articles.summary: Travis Kelce's return to Ohio was supposed to offer a chance to enjoy a quieter life away from the demands of professional football.
articles.body: Travis Kelce's return to Ohio was supposed to offer a chance to enjoy a quieter life away from the demands of professional football. However, settling into his new $5.35 million Bratenahl mansion has brought unexpected complications. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end is now facing resistance from people living nearby, with concerns about his property plans reaching the village's architectural review board. The latest disagreement adds another challenge to Kelce's efforts to establish a private retreat close to his hometown of Cleveland Heights.Travis Kelce's Ohio mansion becomes the center of a neighborhood disputeKelce's latest property troubles have put his new Lake Erie estate under scrutiny. Neighbors recently raised objections at a Village of Bratenahl Architectural Review Board meeting over proposed changes to the rear of the property.While the disagreement involves landscaping, the concerns extend beyond the appearance of the mansion. Residents questioned whether removing existing trees and planting new ones could affect their views of Lake Erie. They also raised concerns about possible damage to a shared sewer line that has reportedly been in place for around a century.Another sticking point was the proposed height of the replacement trees. Bratenahl's regulations set a 10-foot limit, and the original proposal did not meet that requirement.The board decided to delay its decision and requested a revised plan. Officials are expected to revisit the matter at their November 10 meeting.For Kelce, the situation creates an awkward start to life at a property that represents a major investment. The mansion is located just a few miles from Cleveland Heights, where the NFL star grew up. His connection to Ohio runs deep, making the purchase more than just another luxury real estate deal.Travis Kelce's privacy concerns add another layer to Ohio mansion dramaThe neighborhood disagreement comes after Kelce and his wife, Taylor Swift, reportedly introduced additional security measures at the property.According to Page Six, the couple installed an audible warning system designed to alert people who get too close to the estate. One neighbor described an encounter with the system to the publication.“A neighbor approached the house and got a voice warning about not passing onto the property after getting too close to the house,” another neighbor told the publication.The security arrangements have also drawn attention to privacy concerns surrounding the couple's arrival in Bratenahl. The village already has its own police force, although discussions about additional security have reportedly emerged as high-profile residents move into the area.Kelce purchased the $5.35 million estate as part of his growing property portfolio. He also owns a mansion near Kansas City, reportedly worth around $6 million, and previously bought a home in the city's Briarcliff West neighborhood.His Ohio investment gives him another place close to family and familiar surroundings. However, the latest neighborhood dispute suggests that enjoying the privacy and comfort of his new home may take more work than expected.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Patriots lose AJ Brown to injury again, rule out other offensive players ahead of matchup with division rival
articles.summary: A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson and Marcus Bryant were all downgraded to out ahead of the New England Patriots' AFC East clash with the Dolphins.
articles.body: New England’s offense will be shorthanded Sunday, with three players ruled out for the Patriots divisional game against the Miami Dolphins. The Patriots ruled out wide receiver A.J. Brown because of ankle and knee injuries, running back TreVeyon Henderson because of an illness and offensive tackle Marcus Bryant because of an ankle injury. All three players had been listed as questionable before being ruled out. For Brown, the setback comes after he injured his ankle in the season opener and spent the next four games on injured reserve with a high ankle sprain. He returned to play in each of the past two games. 'I MEAN, CLEARLY,' JALEN HURTS TELLS GQ WHEN ASKED IF HE AND A.J. BROWN GREW APART IN PHILADELPHIA Brown appeared to suffer the injury while attempting to make a catch at Lumen Field against the Seattle Seahawks on Sept. 9 during the NFL’s first regular-season game played on a Wednesday. The matchup was billed as a rematch of Super Bowl LX, which Seattle won in February by defeating New England 29-10 to claim the franchise’s second Vince Lombardi Trophy. Brown went down after a Seahawks defender rolled into him and remained on the field after the play. After medical personnel tended to Brown on the field, he made his way to the sideline without assistance. He was later ruled out for the remainder of the game because of what was described as an ankle injury. He finished that night with three catches for 26 yards. articles.title: Golden State Valkyries set ‘Super Bowl era’ record with historic WNBA championship win
articles.summary: The Golden State Valkyries have done something no other American sports franchise has managed after winning their first WNBA championship. Across professiona...
articles.body:
The Golden State Valkyries have done something no other American sports franchise has managed after winning their first WNBA championship.

Across professional sports in the US, expansion teams are often looked at as franchises who need time to become a serious force in their leagues. Many teams who have been added late have failed to make noticeable impacts for decades. The Golden State Valkyries have shown they do not have to be like that..

After beating the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in Game 7 of the WNBA Finals on Saturday night, the Valkyries secured their first-ever championship. Considering that this is only the second year they have existed as a team, they have officially set a mark no team has managed in the 'Super Bowl era' of professional sports in the United States.

Golden State Valkyries become the first team to win in just their second year as a franchise

In 2025, when the Valkyries joined the WNBA, they acquired most of their roster through the expansion draft. This included players like Veronica Burton and Kayla Thornton. They weren't satisfied with just what they had despite making the playoffs, adding Gabby Williams and Kiah Stokes in 2026.

Their moves and head coach Natalie Nakase's basketball savvy have resulted in the Valkyries franchise achieving something no other team has managed.

"Golden State becomes the fastest expansion team in American pro sports history (Super Bowl era) to win a title," Underdog reported. The closest any team has been to this record is the 1970-71 Milwaukee Bucks, who won in their third season. So the Valkyries have made outright history.

It is hard to imagine any team beating this record anytime soon. The way the WNBA is growing, any new contenders for it are likely to arrive within that league itself. For now, Golden State stands alone and they deserve all the flowers for their incredible achievement.

articles.title: 3 questions Cowboys must answer to beat the Cardinals in Week 8
articles.summary: Can Dallas change its mentality, run the ball, and put up touchdowns are questions Dallas must answer before they face the Cardinals in Week 8
articles.body:
The Cowboys beat division rival Philadelphia 38-21 to snap a two-game losing streak, and are now headed home to try for their first winning streak of the season. T he trade deadline looms and the team is deciding whether they'll be buying again. The team struggled defensively against mostly Eagles backups, but their offense stepped up with their best rushing game of the season and timely touchdown passes in the red zone. Dallas fans might have different opinions on the Cowboys' biggest rivals, but their biggest nemesis would seem to be the Arizona Cardinals .

The team is 1-8 against the Cardinals in their last nine contests, including 0-4 at AT&T Stadium, with four of their last five losses by double digits. Dallas was usually the favorite and considered the more talented team in most of those matchups, but Arizona has had their number. The Cowboys will need to answer some questions to finally get over the hump against a Cardinals team that upset the Los Angeles Rams two weeks ago.

Can Dallas continue to score touchdowns?

Dallas is seen as possibly the worst defense in the NFL, but when they match up with Arizona, it's the Cardinals who could be. They are last in scoring defense; the Cowboys are 23rd. Total yards allowed: Dallas is 29th compared to 24th for the Cardinals; EPA per play is an advantage for Arizona, 27th to 30th. They are tied at 20th in passing defense, and the Cowboys are the worst in the NFL in rushing defense.

The major difference is on the offensive side. Dallas is a top-five scoring unit and top-10 in total yards, while the Cardinals are 26th and 22nd, respectively. Both teams stink defensively and should move the ball on the other, but only one has played offense at a level to expose the other. Dallas ranks third in red-zone touchdown percentage, scoring at 74%, while Arizona ranks last at 43%.

Can Dallas continue their run game momentum?

Dallas hasn't been a good rushing team , partly due to a lack of attempts and partly to poor execution when they do hand the ball off. Going into their Week 8 breakout game in Philadelphia, they were 31st at 76 yards per game and dead last in attempts. Things improved drastically after the 200-yard rushing performance against the Philadelphia Eagles . That moved them up to 25th in the NFL with 94 yards per game.

Cowboys opponents have made it a strategy to keep the ball away from Prescott and wear down the defense, and that's why the run game is so important. The Cardinals are fourth in time of possession while the Cowboys are 29th. With Dallas' red zone advantage, if they can control the time of possession and keep their defense off the field, it could be key to a Dallas victory.

The Cowboys need a change in mentality. Confidence isn't an issue, but they have moved into the cocky category and might not even realize its impact on their play. Prescott has mentioned losing to teams they "didn't expect to lose to." Under head coach Brian Schottenheimer, the team has an under-.500 record , and hasn't beaten an NFC team outside of their own division. They shouldn't have the mentality that they should beat anybody.

The Cardinals have been the beneficiary of that mentality for multiple seasons. When Lamb was asked about the Cowboys' struggles against Arizona, he said they were "always too relaxed," and then the Cardinals would "punch them in the mouth." He went on to say they have to "treat them like they are Super Bowl contenders," but the Cowboys aren't that, so why do they play with that mentality? This thought process has to change. Stop talking about the greatest offense there is; become the team that's most prepared and plays harder than anybody else, and they'll win more games.

You can find Mike Crum on Twitter @cdpiglet or on YouTube at Across the Cowboys podcast

A loss to the Cardinals would quickly erase those positive feelings. The Cowboys are looking to avoid a letdown against the NFC West's last-place team, which sits just 2-5 through seven weeks.

The Cowboys flashed the kind of offense they expected to have against the Eagles, getting a season-best performance out of RB Javonte Williams while Dak Prescott flashed a connection with CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens. The defense, on the other hand, continues to be a mixed bag.
